'ween') · wēn — hope, expectation (noun, accusative singular feminine; þæs ic wēn hæbbe 'I have hope of that') · wēn — hope, expectation (noun, nominative singular feminine, subject of wæs ālumpen; wistfylle wēn 'hope of a full meal')
__broaden__.wīnsele: wīnsele — wine-hall, banqueting hall (masculine, dative singular; wīn 'wine' + sele 'hall') · wīnsele — wine-hall (masculine, nominative singular; se wīnsele wiðhæfde 'the wine-hall withstood')
__broaden__.wōp: wōp — weeping, lamentation (nominative singular; related to 'weep') · wōp — weeping, outcry (accusative singular, object of gehȳrdon; of wealle wōp gehȳrdon 'heard the outcry from the wall')
__broaden__.þon: þon — than (the manuscript's own form, kept by Klaeber; most editors emend to þon[ne]) · þon — by that, the (instrumental of the demonstrative; þon mā 'the more, any more') · þon — that (instrumental of the demonstrative; æfter þon 'after that'; ǣr þon 'before', as a conjunction 'ere')
__broaden__.þæs: þæt — for that, of that (genitive singular of the demonstrative: 'comfort for that') · se — of the (genitive singular neuter article, before a noun: þæs recedes 'of the hall') · þes — this (demonstrative, nominative singular masculine; the manuscript's þæs for þes, in þæs sele 'this hall') · þæs — so, to that degree (genitive singular of the demonstrative used adverbially; þæs fæste 'so firmly') · þæs — of this (genitive, as object of wēndon: Þæs ne wēndon 'did not expect this')
__broaden__.þǣr: þǣr — there (adverb) · þǣr — where (relative adverb; þǣr ic fīfe geband 'where I bound five') · þǣr — if, provided that (conjunction; þǣr hē meahte swā 'if he could so')
__broaden__.gesæt: gesittan — sat (in council) (3rd singular preterite) · gesittan — sat, took a seat in (1st singular preterite; takes the accusative) · gesittan — sat, sat up (3rd singular preterite; wið earm gesæt 'sat up against his arm', the exact sense uncertain)
__broaden__.ǣr: ǣr — before, previously (adverb; cf. archaic 'ere') · ǣr — before (conjunction; ǣr gē 'before you') · ǣr — sooner, earlier (adverb, with a comparative sense; nō þȳ ǣr 'none the sooner')
